thread:
Anya (Content): ok team — kicking off a 1-week micro tutorial sprint. goal: 4 short tutorials (3-5 steps each) that show devs how to wire Redwood API into common stacks. think: Next.js, Rails, Flask, and a Rust example. quick, focused, code-first.
Jamie (DevRel): love it. can we also make one reference app that ties two of those (Next + Redwood hosted) so folks can clone and run? :thumbsup:
Sam (Marketing): timeline? we have the webinar slot on Thu week after next, better if we have at least 2 tutorials + refapp by then for promo.
Anya (Content): proposing sprint schedule: Day 0 planning + templating, Day 1-3 write + code, Day 4 review + test, Day 5 publish + social.
Chris (Eng): I can help with the Rust example (small server + example request). will need a short boilerplate repo.
Natalie (SEO): heads up — please include clear H2s with keywords: "Redwood API", "LLM inference", "embed models". also include short meta description and schema for code samples.
Jamie (DevRel): I can record 3 short screencasts (2-3 mins each) to embed in the tutorials. do we want captions?
Sam (Marketing): yes captions. also we should prepare 3 tweet threads and a short LinkedIn post per tutorial. I'll mock copy. include CTAs: try hosted API, star the refapp, signup for the webinar.
Anya (Content): assign owners: Next.js — Jamie; Rails — Sam (pair with Chris); Flask — Anya; Rust — Chris. Refapp (Next + hosted) — Jamie lead, Chris support.
Chris (Eng): noted. I'll open the Rust repo and the refapp skeleton tonight.
Jamie (DevRel): quick question: what's the inbound lead flow? do we route tutorial signups to the community nurture list or sales?
Sam (Marketing): tutorials -> community nurture by default. webinar registrants -> sales-assisted for enterprise accounts (we flag based on company email domain). we'll add a UTM+hidden form field to capture intent.
Natalie (SEO): also add canonical tags for the refapp repo README to avoid duplicate content.
Anya (Content): content format: short intro (1-2 paragraphs), 3-5 numbered steps, code block for the main snippet, and a "Try it" section with curl + minimal SDK examples. include example prompt sets for the tutorial.
Jamie (DevRel): sample code snippet idea:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-3b","input":"translate hello to spanish"}'
```
Sam (Marketing): for launch posts: short blog post + one long-form reference tutorial per stack. schedule social drip: day 0 announcement, day 2 deep dive, day 5 refapp demo clip, day 7 webinar reminder.
Anya (Content): QA checklist: run examples with free demo key, validate outputs, screenshot responses, verify build + deploy instructions. Chris—please add CI that runs the sample call once on PRs (even just smoke).
Chris (Eng): will add GH Actions workflow: smoke-test.yml that runs a single curl against a mocked endpoint.
Jamie (DevRel): can we include a short benchmark note (latency example) in the Next.js tutorial? people love concrete numbers.
Sam (Marketing): yes but keep it simple — median p95 for a 256-token generation on hosted -> ~120ms (placeholder until runtime team confirms). add a note: "benchmarks from internal tests, results may vary".
Natalie (SEO): I'll write SEO titles and slugs (one-liners) after drafts are up.
Anya (Content): blockers?
Jamie (DevRel): need access to the staging API key for dev recordings. @deploy-bot who handles keys?
deploy-bot: shared-staging-key created and posted to #secrets-ops. rotated yesterday. permission: marketing/devrel have read-only.
Sam (Marketing): creatives — do we need screenshots sized for Twitter/LinkedIn? I can get a designer to make 2 variants.
Anya (Content): yes, get 1200x630 and 800x800. Sam—please add to the task card.
Jamie (DevRel): volunteer notes: I'll take Next.js + refapp vids, Chris takes Rust + CI, Sam drafts Rails tutorial with me pairing, Anya handles Flask and overall copy.
Anya (Content): perfect. I'll create the Notion planning doc and link PR templates. doc: https://notion.so/redwood-micro-tutorial-sprint (placeholder)
Sam (Marketing): when we publish, add UTM params: utm_source=social&utm_medium=refapp&utm_campaign=micro_tutorial_sprint. also add a short form to refapp README for feedback (checkbox: demo / integrate / enterprise).
Natalie (SEO): one more: add og:image meta to each tutorial page (use final hero image).
Anya (Content): wrap-up: owners assigned, tasks in board, sprint starts tomorrow morning. any last items?
Chris (Eng): reminder — let's keep the code samples MIT license and include CONTRIBUTING.md.
Jamie (DevRel): :rocket: excited. I'll post a sticky note in #devrel when vids are uploaded.
Anya (Content): thanks all — I'll post the planning doc and a short sprint checklist in the channel.
Sam (Marketing): noted. I'll draft social copy and share for review by EOD tomorrow.
text_snippet: micro tutorial sprint kickoff: 4 tutorials + refapp, owners assigned, deadline timeline, production checklist, inbound routing to community nurture
